view_targets.label: Sydney CBD towers (upper part)
view_targets.note: line of sight to a point 200 m above ground in the CBD (the towers there are ~200–310 m tall)

view_targets.label: Botany Bay (water)
view_targets.note: line of sight to the water surface at four points in the bay

view_targets.label: Sydney Airport runways
view_targets.note: line of sight to 10 m above the airfield (tail height of a taxiing jet)

view_method: For each building, level and facade aspect: eye at ground datum + level × floor-to-floor (est.) + 1.6 m, at the facade midpoint. A target counts as visible if the straight line to it clears the terrain (AWS Terrain Tiles, z13) and every OpenStreetMap building with a mapped height on the way, plus the other three buildings of this project, within ±60° of the facade direction. On land, the line must also clear 8 m above ground everywhere beyond 20 m (a conservative allowance for unmapped houses and trees). Earth curvature with standard refraction applied. Trees, unmapped buildings and future neighbours are not in the model.

notes: Massing model from public planning documents: shapes are typical-floor outlines traced from the approved 2022 plans; MOD-4 (2024) changed facades and heights, so the top is shown at the current approved maximum RL. Not an architectural model and not photoreal.
Heights above ground are estimates: approved maximum RL minus the ground datum implied by the 2022 assessment report.
Floor heights are estimates (equal floor-to-floor per building).
